guard: installed Hermes metadata makes manager boot accept the documented uv-only setup and reject a hermes-only PATH that the shipped launcher cannot use
why: The smoke derives cached requirements from the built shipped Hermes connector, then starts the
real manager boot inspection against an owned broker for uv-only and hermes-only PATH arms.
Each mutation rebuilds Hermes first, so source changes reach the bundled artifact the smoke imports.

mutations.name: Hermes metadata inspects the unused hermes executable instead of uv, restoring the uv-only false negative
mutations.expectRed: documented uv-only Hermes install is available at manager boot
mutations.cell: documented uv-only Hermes install is available at manager boot

mutations.name: Hermes metadata inspects the unused hermes executable instead of uv, restoring the hermes-only false positive
mutations.expectRed: hermes-only PATH is unavailable because the shipped launcher requires uv
